results.name: physics-app-integration
results.tail:
PASS Actual app driving, reversing and fuel agree at 30, 60 and 120 Hz
PASS A long render stall advances only the bounded physics budget and leaves no catch-up debt
PASS Road gradient matches the rendered height convention and influences actual driving
PASS Lateral sliding consumes true path fuel and camera distance without inventing wheel travel
PASS Zero-duration app frames never repeat previous path, fuel use or camera distance
PASS Held wheel plus a second-pointer gear change brakes before rolling in reverse
PASS A real off-centre road contact changes planar momentum without a teleport
PASS Blur, resize and hidden-tab safety resets clear every planar momentum channel
PASS Overview pause, garage return and re-entry clear stale forces, spin and teleport distance
PASS Empty fuel with sideways/angular momentum returns safely and cannot pay a coincident delivery
PASS All ten vehicle configurations retain finite dynamics and their own fuel accounting
Planar app integration: 11/11 checks passed.

results.name: road-hazards-app
results.tail:
PASS 100 real app biome transitions preserve ownership, fuel and reward protection for stock/max cars
PASS Hazard contact participates in actual swept solver, fuel and D/R for all ten cars
PASS Rock simulation pauses for menus, blur, hidden, overview and context loss; resets do not farm
PASS Soft patches modify only their finite footprints and are wired into all actual car models
PASS Fuel zero, ordinary abort and regeneration clear pooled hazard state without payout
Hazard app integration: 5/5 checks passed
